svg.title: Wooden bench — placement, power and signals

g.text: Complete overhead placement / IKEA KNAGGLIG, 460 × 310 mm / supplier photographs with schematic wire routes
REAR EDGE • converter sits upright on the outside rear wall
SDA8 / SCL3 via LV ↔ HV shifter
Jack + → A input • A / 5 A → converter +Vin • converter +Vo → B input
B6 also feeds LCD and logic.
GPIO12 → DIN row 1. Green jumpers carry data. Give each row its own fused +5 V and return pair.
Strip photographs identify cut lengths schematically. Feed each 30-pixel row at both ends from its own branch.
Blue = GPIO signal. Purple = ESP 3V3 → momentary switch COM. NO returns to the labelled input. Dashed orange leads stay parked.
Drain: GPIO1 → COM; BALL HELD throw → GND; EMPTY throw open. Boot in EMPTY. Start LED: GPIO14 → 1 kΩ → LED → GND; Launch LED: GPIO2 likewise.
Common 0 V: jack −, converter −Vin and −Vo, fuse-block negative buses, ESP GND, drivers and load returns. Keep external +5 V off the ESP headers.
12 V input limit: DDR-60G-5 supplies 8.1 A at 5 V. The full-white estimate is 8.53 A. Use reduced brightness and verify current under load.
Fuses, modules and photos are enlarged for tracing. Verify mounting footprints, rear ventilation and cable clearance on the actual box before drilling.
Click product photos for details. APEM publishes a generic 5000-series image for the drain. DIP buffer, I²C shifter and discrete LEDs are identified by connection.
Photo sources: Freenove, Marine Deals, converter nameplate listing, Kunkune, SK Pang, Botland, Furneaux Riddall, The Saber Armory, RS, Arcade Parts UK, Hobby Components, APEM.
